_note: This is a feed ABOUT the news industry, not a news feed. Ordinary reporting
is refused by the subject gate — every term carries the industry words it
direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for the monitors, indices and recurring reports.
official  regulators, courts, UN bodies and rapporteurs
research  media monitoring, ownership and trust research
press     general news across the locales
rights    press freedom and journalist organisations
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: Reporters Without Borders, the
Committee to Protect Journalists, IPI, IFJ, the Reuters Institute, NewsGuard,
Nieman Lab, Press Gazette, the Media Freedom Rapid Response and Rest of World.
